description: This file defines functions related to managing system email templates in SuiteCRM, including installing, upgrading, setting defaults, and retrieving templates.

methods.name: installSystemEmailTemplates
methods.description: Installs system email templates by loading template data and saving new template beans if they do not already exist in the config.

methods.name: upgradeSystemEmailTemplates
methods.description: Calls the installation function to upgrade email templates.

methods.name: setSystemEmailTemplatesDefaultConfig
methods.description: Sets default configuration values for system email templates in the global config.

methods.name: getSystemEmailTemplates
methods.description: Returns an array of predefined system email templates, including subject, description, and body content.
